steps._note: WO-1378 beat 1/2, creative canon section 8.1 (the strings are transcribed, not invented). WHY THE CANON'S FIRST TWO MOMENTS - 'Barracks completed' and 'first army granted' - ARE ONE BEAT AND NOT TWO: contextual beats CANNOT be chained off each other. TutorialFlow.OnSignal completes a live hint on its own dialogue.ended and RETURNS (TutorialFlow.cs:1515-1523), so the same raise never reaches TryTriggerContextual (:1526); and TryTriggerContextual refuses outright while another hint is live (:2492). A second beat keyed on 'dialogue.ended:tut_ctx_raid_barracks' would therefore never fire once - a dead beat, which is the exact class this file's own reachability suite exists to prevent. The two moments also genuinely coincide: StarterArmyGrant issues the free squad the first time a save has a Barracks, so one beat says both true things at the moment they are both true. TRIGGER CAVEAT, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the canon line says the Barracks STANDS READY, but the only barracks-shaped signal any live emitter raises is build.structure_placed:barracks, which fires at PLACEMENT (TutorialSignalAdapters.OnStructurePlaced -> StructurePlacedPrefix + entryId). The real completion edge is StarterArmyGrant's rising edge on StructureSingleton.IsBuilt("barracks"), which raises no tutorial signal today; closing that gap needs a new emitter in TutorialSignalAdapters (another lane's file). ALSO FLAGGED, NOT DECIDED: the canon line hardcodes "Three" while the squad size is a tunable (RemoteTunables.KeyRaidStarterArmySize, default 3) and StarterArmyGrant.GrantToastFor deliberately builds its own count from the ACTUAL number granted. Catalog id verified this run: structures-catalog.json entry "barracks", type Resource, reachable in the Town palette and not in its lockedIds - so the trigger can actually fire, and the troop it grants is id "troop-footman".

objective.text: Heartfire sends you on a raid - you hold three

steps._note: WO-1415 - THE HEARTFIRE INTRODUCTION, fired the FIRST time the player opens the RAIDS GRID and never at founding: a player who has just founded a town has nothing to spend a charge on, while a player looking at the camp list is one tap from spending one. Trigger raids.grid_opened is raised by RaidSelectionScreen.OpenInternal AFTER the WO-1374 capability gate, the army gate and the modal arbiter have all passed - a player refused at the door is never taught about the charge that was not their blocker. IT IS NOT panel.opened:<PanelId>: the raid grid registers with PanelManager ('Raids'), not PanelRouter, so no member of that family is ever raised for it and a beat authored against panel.opened:Raids would never fire. RAISED ON EVERY OPEN on purpose - TryTriggerContextual refuses while another hint is live (TutorialFlow.cs:2492), so one raise could be swallowed; re-raising per open makes the next visit the retry, with no timer and no second mechanism, and the tutorial_ctx one-shot latch on seenTutorials dedupes (NO schema bump). KNOWN AND STATED: the grid owns the modal arbiter while it is up, so DialogueView starts this beat HIDDEN and restores it the frame the grid closes (the WO-795 truce - DialogueView.cs:161 and TickModalTruce :574-599 - the VM stays open and Ended is NOT fired). The player therefore reads the panel coming back out of the grid, and its door offers to take them straight back in. COMPLETES ON ITS OWN dialogue.ended, the ctx_raid_first shape: this is an INTRODUCTION, not a WO-1340 teach beat - there is no 'real tap' that proves a player understood a charge, and the thing it asks for (spend one) is the raid the grid is already offering. NEVER GATES: contextual, pausePressure false, oneShot, skippable, no highlight (there is no raid-grid id in TutorialHighlightRegistry.KnownIds and DataRegression reds an invented one). The mandatory chain is still exactly the eight WO-1012 founding beats (tutorial-reach Case 6). Pinned by tutorial-reach Case 9 [heartfire-intro].
